principle: Migrate semantics and receipts before moving bytes; every physical placement step remains reversible until target evidence closes correctness/recovery gates.

phases.name: inventory_and_shadow_identity
phases.changes: No data movement. Classify current objects/stores by semantic role, transaction domain, derivation lineage and admissibility class.
phases.gate: complete role matrix and source/rebuild lineage

phases.name: typed_logical_facade
phases.changes: Put current stores behind UnifiedQueryIR/TCQS contracts without changing physical placement.
phases.gate: query-result equivalence on representative corpus; no implicit collection-type changes

phases.name: causal_receipts
phases.changes: Add source-epoch, derivation-version, query/selection and representation receipts in shadow mode.
phases.rollback: disable receipt enforcement while retaining observations

phases.name: canonical_derivation_spine
phases.changes: Route non-authoritative graph/vector/FTS/activation maintenance through durable derivation/outbox semantics where appropriate.
phases.rollback: dual-write to legacy path until replay parity holds

phases.name: selection_integrity
phases.changes: For exposed selectors, compare current selection with authenticated-structure or equivalent trusted selection path before consequential use.
phases.gate: selection mutation suite and measured overhead
phases.rollback: fall back to exact/validated retrieval path

phases.name: same_process_compute_fusion
phases.changes: Move selected high-affinity query computation into one address space while keeping data/index stores physically replaceable.
phases.gate: semantic equivalence plus p50/p95/p99 improvement and acceptable fault coupling

phases.name: selective_index_or_data_replacement
phases.changes: Independently test colocated vs decoupled graph/vector/FTS storage/index layouts per workload.
phases.gate: matched result/recall, write amplification, storage, rebuild and recovery
phases.rollback: rebuild prior sidecar from canonical source

phases.name: selective_transaction_colocation
phases.changes: Only data proven to require one atomic effect-critical transition is moved into the same transaction domain.
phases.gate: fault injection, crash/restart and migration rollback
phases.rollback: restore canonical spine plus derivation log

phases.name: linux_target_trace
phases.changes: Replay real FRANK workload traces through competing placement vectors.

phases.name: android_edge_lowering
phases.changes: Keep the same semantic/query contracts while selecting smaller device-specific physical engines and cache/index policies.
phases.gate: sustained RAM, storage, battery/energy, thermal, prefill/decode and recovery measurements
phases.rollback: device adapter switch without semantic migration

stop_conditions: selection receipt cannot explain candidate origin
physical optimization increases common-mode failure beyond accepted threshold
migration cannot be reversed from preserved canonical data
